title: Capsule baked font
description: A font baked at one size from a TrueType or OpenType face: printable ASCII, Latin-1, every character the game's string tables use, and any further characters.

$schema.description: The URL of this file's JSON Schema, which gives an editor completion and hover. The build ignores its value.

face.description: The face, a .ttf or .otf file, relative to this file. The face itself never ships.

size.description: The em in canvas pixels, the size a pixel font is drawn on its grid at.

fallback.description: Faces relative to this file, in order, each supplying the characters the faces before it lack. Line spacing is the first face's.

characters.description: Further characters to bake, for text the string tables do not hold.

antialias.description: Whether glyph edges blend. False keeps every pixel whole, as a pixel font drawn at its design size wants.

tables.description: Whether every character the game's string tables use is baked. False bakes printable ASCII, Latin-1 and "characters" alone, as a display font wants.
